Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. 

Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless.  That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.

We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it.

As a Sales Manager for Strategic Accounts, you’ll own the performance of a team selling into some of the world’s largest organizations. You’ll be responsible for delivering ambitious revenue goals, hiring and developing exceptional Account Executives, and getting directly involved in the accounts and deals where your judgment and experience can make a difference.

If you’re excited by the challenge of building a high-performing team while staying close to the business, you’ll thrive here. You’ll be a trusted partner to senior customer executives, help your team navigate its most important opportunities, and work across Airtable to turn what you learn from customers into better ways of selling, operating, and ultimately serving them.

What you'll do

  • Own your team’s revenue performance, setting ambitious goals and creating the focus, accountability, and operating rhythm needed to deliver against them.
  • Build and develop an exceptional team of Strategic Account Executives through thoughtful hiring, hands-on coaching, and regular, actionable feedback.
  • Stay close to your most important accounts and opportunities, helping shape deal and account strategy and building trusted relationships with senior customer executives.

title: Contract Technical Recruiter
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Clover Health’s People Operations team is the strategic force behind our human capital management. We attract and recruit top talent and we’re proud of our data-driven approach to talent engagement and feel privileged to support our global workforce. We’re looking for an experienced Contract Technical Recruiter to join our high-performing Talent Acquisition team for a six-month engagement supporting our subsidiary, Counterpart Health, partnering with stakeholders across every team to understand business objectives, develop strategic hiring plans, and recruit amazing talent.

Our ideal candidate has experience recruiting for a variety of technical skill sets ideally in the HealthTech space and is eager to take on the challenge of our growing company and working with some of the best tools on the market. Most importantly, you are excited to experiment with new approaches to talent acquisition in order to build a best in class team at Clover Health.

As a Contract Technical Recruiter you will:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for a subset of Clover's technology teams. Partner with hiring managers to understand role scope and business needs in order to build out effective job descriptions, hiring/interview plans and targeted sourcing strategies.
  • Track, analyze, and share pipeline and performance data with hiring teams and internal recruiting partners, facilitate good decision making and advise on roadblocks in tandem with recommended solutions to deliver top talent.
  • Find ways to enhance the Clover talent brand to attract top talent. Develop creative sourcing tactics to actively engage passive candidates and increase pipeline diversity.
  • Use market intelligence and funnel metrics to inform your search strategy and build a trusting relationship with leaders and hiring managers.
  • Serve as the first point of contact with prospective candidates through effectively pitching Clover and the hiring teams.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Self-driven to gather and organize the data you need to build and execute successful searches leveraging AI and automation wherever possible. 
  • You consistently show up as a strategic partner with strong data insights to inform good decision making. 
  • You actively come up with solutions to problems and influence both candidates and hiring teams and manage changing environments and priorities seamlessly. 

You should get in touch with us if:

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as a technical recruiter with at least a year of in-house experience, preferably in a high growth HealthTech organization
  • You have a proven track record of sourcing, assessing, and pitching candidates with niche skill sets and strong understanding of the US HealthTech space.
  • You have a high sense of accountability and ownership, you drive processes and facilitate good decision making. 
  • You are committed to comprehensive search, candidate and pipeline data and have direct experience using data to influence hiring teams and candidates. 
  • You have experience leveraging Greenhouse, GEM, LinkedIn and AI tooling to develop job descriptions, hiring plans, and talent maps for unique and niche roles. 

Benefits Overview:

  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. 
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents

We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

 

About the Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This role is based in the greater Southern CA area, reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers

  • Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals

  • Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning

  • Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals

title: Care Coach
description:
Headquarters: Remote

Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role: 

We are looking for a mission-driven health coach to join our team to provide world-class care delivery services to Maven members. Our Care Delivery team consists of care coaches and care advocates who help our members navigate digital care and access the tools to unlock their best experience and outcomes. Our team works to continuously learn more about members and ourselves, and you’ll move fast to adapt and grow as we implement data-driven strategies for improving the lives of our members through a shared coaching model. As a Care Coach, you’ll coordinate care for our members beyond the digital space. Through goal setting and program opt-in, you’ll drive behavior change and improved outcomes for higher risk members. 

Our Care Delivery team works remotely and supports Maven members 24/7/365. We are currently hiring for the following shift:

  • Monday-Friday 3-11:30p EST

What You’ll Do:

  • Drive program engagement by clearly communicating the value of Maven’s care coaching model, optimizing opt-in rates, and supporting long-term behavior change
  • Co-create SMART goals with members and own their progress by tracking adherence, adjusting care plans, and course-correcting within Maven’s clinical program design
  • Manage a caseload of members and engage with them through ongoing messaging, video appointments, and outreach
  • Adhere to clinical program guidelines and protocols while utilizing motivational interviewing skills and behavior modification techniques to remove barriers, influence sustained behavior change, and promote optimal health outcomes for members
  • Move fast to assess member knowledge and barriers and provide personalized health education to members across varying ages, backgrounds, cultures, and literacy levels
  • Collaborate with providers on members’ care teams to translate clinical recommendations into actionable next steps
  • Lead with data by remotely monitoring member health data and platform activity to identify risks early and follow established protocols and procedures to take appropriate action
  • Remove barriers to care by coordinating seamlessly across Maven’s digital network, in-person provider networks, and external partners as needed
  • Embrace a continuous-learning mindset by participating in and leading efforts to improve quality of care and clinical outcomes
  • Act as a team player by providing coverage to ensure that all members across the Maven platform receive appropriate care and timely responses when needed

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 1- 2+ years experience in clinical work as a nurse (RN) with focus on patient education, motivational interviewing, and driving clinical outcomes
  • Demonstrated experience working with the maternity population and/or individuals navigating family planning or fertility care (trying to conceive, undergoing fertility treatment)
  • Training and experience coaching individuals to achieve specific health outcomes (ie, medication management, nutrition and exercise goals, managing blood pressure)
  • Ability to remain flexible with changes, work efficiently to meet member demand and have a growth mindset
  • Ability to communicate with patients empathetically in writing and verbally, and passionate about creating a positive member experience with optimal outcomes  
  • Experience achieving KPIs relevant to patient outcomes, including but not limited to opt-in rates, follow-up adherence and member satisfaction 
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and adapt to new digital health tools and platforms, with comfort operating in a fast-changing tech environment
  • Embrace AI tools as part of daily workflows to enhance efficiency and improve member outcomes
  • Strong telehealth competency, including comfort in conducting phone outreach and video calls. Reliable access to high-speed internet
  • Health coaching certification (NBC-HWC or ICF) is preferred, not required 
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-paced environment with ability to navigate systems quickly and adapt to change is preferred, not required 
  • Experience coaching across multiple modalities such as video, text/chat, and phone; adapting communication style to fit member need is preferred, not required 
  • Comfort with technology tools like Google suite, CRM platforms, EHRs, and Zendesk is preferred, not required 

The base salary range for this role is $62,000 - $78,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

title: Global Alliance Lead, Capgemini
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Colorado, United States, AMER

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the role

The Global Alliance Lead is one of the most strategically important roles in our Ecosystem. You will own our relationship with one of the world's leading technology and transformation partners end-to-end — from C-suite engagement through to practitioner enablement and joint pipeline creation. You will be the architect of how the GSI and NewCo go to market together, ensuring our platform becomes the trusted data foundation inside the GSI’s agentic AI delivery practice globally.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Global Head of GSI Relationships. You will orchestrate across sales, partner solution architecture, marketing, and partner operations — bringing the full weight of the organisation to bear on one of our highest-leverage commercial relationships.

What You'll Do

Relationship strategy and executive engagement

  • Own the global GSI relationship at partner and C-suite level, building trusted relationships with Client, practice and delivery team leads.
  • Define and execute a multi-year joint strategy that positions dbt + Fivetran as the default open data infrastructure layer within the GSI’s enterprise AI and agentic workflow delivery
  • Represent NewCo at GSI’s internal forums, client briefings, and industry events — articulating a compelling narrative around open data infrastructure and its relevance to the GSI’s strategy. 

Platform integration and practitioner adoption

  • Drive adoption of the dbt + Fivetran platform within GSI delivery teams — ensuring practitioners, solution architects and practice leads are certified, confident, and actively recommending the platform in client engagements
  • Work with GSI's practice leadership to embed NewCo's platform into their business groups, standard delivery architectures, RFP responses and client proposals — with particular focus on GSI's Data & AI practices

Enablement and go-to-market

  • Design and execute a frictionless enablement programme for GSI practitioners globally — certifications, reference architectures, use case playbooks, and joint delivery assets
  • Partner with GSI's marketing and alliances teams to develop joint go-to-market campaigns anchored to open data infrastructure, trusted AI delivery, and closing the gap between AI POC and production
  • Support GSI in building and positioning client-facing agentic AI value accelerators — with NewCo platform as the foundational data layer — the "NewCo inside" model

Pipeline and opportunity development

  • Source and develop new pipeline opportunities through the GSI relationship — identifying client situations where open data infrastructure creates measurable value.
  • Drive co-sell motions alongside GSI account teams, ensuring NewCo is present and influential at the point of client opportunity
  • Maintain a rigorous view of GSI-engaged pipeline — tracking opportunity sourcing, progression, and closed business attributed to the alliance

Telemetry and performance

  • Define and track the signals that indicate a healthy, high-performing GSI relationship: certifications, sourced opportunities, platform deployments, practitioner engagement, and joint wins
  • Report regularly to the Global Head of GSI Relationships on alliance health, pipeline contribution, and strategic progress
  • Identify risks and gaps in the relationship early and mobilise internal resources to address them

What you will bring

  • 15+ years of experience in strategic alliances, enterprise sales, or partner management within the data, cloud, or enterprise software industry
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, global relationships with major consulting firms or global system integrators at a senior level
  • Deep understanding of the modern data stack and the business value of open data infrastructure — dbt, Fivetran, or equivalent experience strongly preferred
  • Ability to engage credibly at C-suite and partner level within a global consulting organisation — understanding how GSIs make decisions, build practices, and go to market
  • Strong commercial instincts — able to identify, thoroughly qualify and develop joint pipeline opportunities, not just manage existing relationships
  • Track record of operating as a cross-functional orchestrator — influencing without direct authority across sales, engineering, marketing, and operations
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills — able to translate technical platform capabilities into compelling business narratives for consulting and enterprise audiences
  • Familiarity with AI, agentic workflows, and the data governance landscape is a strong advantage + strong knowledge of GSI's operating model and contacts within. 
  • Willingness to travel globally to engage GSI leadership and teams across regions

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • A clearly defined joint strategy with GSI signed off at partner Executive level and on track to primary Global Strategic Practice.
  • Material increase in GSI practitioner certifications and active platform deployments across Data & AI and Insights & Data practices
  • GSI-sourced pipeline contributing measurably to NewCo's revenue
  • At least two joint go-to-market campaigns live in the market delivering pipeline — anchored to GSI's agentic AI and trusted data agenda
  • First client-facing agentic value accelerators built on NewCo platform delivered with GSI — positioning NewCo as the trusted data infrastructure inside GSI's AI delivery
  • A telemetry framework in place tracking alliance health and pipeline influence

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to own a marquee relationship at a defining moment for both companies. GSI’s are publicly committing to capturing the full value of the agentic AI revolution for customers  — and the merged dbt + Fivetran platform is the trusted data infrastructure that makes AI production-ready. The person who builds this alliance well will sit at the intersection of the two most important forces in enterprise technology right now: the scale of a global systems integrator and the open infrastructure that makes AI trustworthy enough to deploy at scale.

This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.

title: VP, Commercial Sales - Employers
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

About Us

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.

About the Role

Galileo is transforming how America's workforce experiences healthcare, and we need an exceptional enterprise sales leader to accelerate our expansion. This role owns the full sales cycle with mid-to-large employers (1,000+ employees), partnering with benefits consultants and brokers to replace fragmented, frustrating healthcare with our virtual-first primary care platform. You'll be equal parts strategist, consultant, and closer—building a territory from the ground up while directly impacting how hundreds of thousands of employees access quality care.

A Day in the Life

You'll spend significant time developing your strategy—researching target accounts, mapping stakeholder landscapes, nurturing broker/consultant relationships, and orchestrating multi-threaded sales campaigns that position Galileo ahead of competitors. Equally important is the consultative aspect of the role: you'll lead discovery conversations with CFOs, CHROs, and benefits teams to diagnose their healthcare challenges, architect custom solutions, and build business cases that survive executive scrutiny. You'll balance independent pipeline development with intensive cross-functional collaboration—partnering with Finance on deal modeling, Legal on contract terms, and Operations on implementation planning—always connecting your work to transforming healthcare delivery for working families.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and build: Develop and execute a multi-year account acquisition strategy for your assigned region/vertical, creating multiple pipeline sources including direct outreach, broker/consultant partnerships, and market trigger identification
  • Drive complex enterprise sales cycles: Manage 12+ month sales processes from initial contact through contract signature, orchestrating engagement across 5-10 stakeholders with competing priorities (C-suite, HR, finance, clinical teams)
  • Build and leverage strategic partnerships: Cultivate relationships with benefits consultants, brokers, and industry influencers who generate recurring qualified opportunities and advocate for Galileo in competitive evaluations
  • Deliver consultative solutions: Lead structured discovery to uncover employer pain points, translate clinical outcomes into financial ROI, and design deal structures that overcome budget and timing obstacles
  • Forecast and report accurately: Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene in Salesforce, provide reliable monthly/quarterly revenue forecasts, and create comprehensive deal documentation that enables seamless cross-functional execution
  • Contribute market intelligence: Serve as a feedback loop to product, marketing, and leadership on competitive dynamics, messaging effectiveness, and emerging customer needs based on frontline insights
  • Ensure successful client launches: Partner with Operations, Finance, Legal, and Client Services throughout the deal lifecycle to align on implementation requirements, success KPIs, and long-term account strategy

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience with documented quota attainment in complex, long-cycle environments
  • 10+ years specifically selling to HR/benefits decision-makers in enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees preferred)
  • Proven track record closing multiple deals with annual contract values of $500K+ (must provide specific examples)
  • Direct experience in one or more of these domains: healthcare/benefits sales (health plans, wellness programs, digital health), insurance/broker channel sales, or HR technology sales
  • Demonstrated CRM proficiency (Salesforce or equivalent) with strong documentation discipline and forecast accuracy
  • Experience managing 12+ month sales cycles with seasonal buying patterns and navigating complex procurement processes
  • Ability to travel approximately 50% and authorization to work in the United States

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You're a market developer, not an order-taker: You've created non-traditional pipeline sources (like partnerships that generated 40%+ of opportunities), identified market triggers before competitors, and developed sophisticated territory strategies beyond basic segmentation
  • You excel at stakeholder orchestration: You've successfully recovered deals after initial rejection by re-engaging through different stakeholders, and you naturally adapt your pitch for CFOs (financial impact), CHROs (employee experience), and clinical leaders (quality outcomes)

  • You bring existing relationships: You have an established network of benefits consultants, brokers, or enterprise contacts you can activate in this role

Benefits & Why Join Us

What You'll Gain:

  • Ownership: Build something from the ground up with entrepreneurial autonomy while backed by a proven platform
  • Mission-driven impact: Every deal you close improves healthcare access for thousands of employees and their families
  • Strategic influence: Your market insights will directly shape Galileo's product, positioning, and go-to-market strategy

Compensation: $150,000 - $200,000 per year based upon prior experience, performance, and market dynamics. This role is eligible for variable compensation. OTE is ~$350,000–$400,000.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
Headquarters: Australia
URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

JobHire.AI is a vertical AI agent that automates job search for professionals in the US market. Why This Role Now

We are spending efficiently to acquire users — but a substantial portion of revenue is left on the table after the first purchase. Reg→Purchase conversion is below where it should be. Rebill rates erode quickly past month one. Add-on attach is minimal. Our reactivation engine is currently offline. We've been operating an email-only CRM on a platform that doesn't return analytics through its API.

That ends with this hire. This is a role for someone who has already done the transformation we need: turning a basic broadcast CRM into a measurable CVM function that drives incremental revenue across email, SMS, and web push — on the US market specifically.

What You'll Own

Funnel Conversion

  • Drive Reg→Purchase conversion through triggered post-quiz, paywall-abandonment, and onboarding sequences across email, SMS, and web push.
  • Own first-purchase activation across the first 7 days.

Retention & Rebill

  • Differentiate renewal sequences by plan tier (1 / 3 / 6 month).
  • Build pre-cancel intervention flows — pause offer, plan-switch, value reminder — using captured cancel reason.
  • Move the dial on month-1 rebill rate, the single most leveraged metric in our subscription economics.

Reactivation

  • Build the reactivation engine for the cancelled cohort — across email and SMS, personalized by cancel reason and tenure.
  • Recover revenue from a base that is currently dormant due to deliverability issues.

Add-on Monetization

  • Own the CRM-driven path to add-on products (Resume Review, Resume Builder): timing, segmentation, copy, channel.

Channel & Tooling

  • Lead the migration off our current ESP onto our chosen omnichannel platform (Maestra is the current candidate; Customer.io is the alternative).
  • Recover and maintain email domain reputation.
  • Stand up SMS as a first-class channel — including US compliance (TCPA, A2P 10DLC).
  • Stand up web push and orchestrate cross-channel flows (email → SMS → push cascades).

Measurement

  • Implement incremental measurement with holdouts on every flow. We don't want activity reports — we want incremental revenue, attributable and defensible.

Expected Outcomes

First 3 Months

  1. Email deliverability restored to historical baseline.
  2. Reactivation campaign launched with measurable incremental conversion against a holdout.
  3. Differentiated renewal flows live for 1 / 3 / 6 month plans.
  4. Decision (signed off with engineering) on omnichannel platform: migrate to Maestra or alternative.

First 6 Months

  1. SMS and web push live as ongoing production channels in lifecycle flows.
  2. Measurable lift in Reg→Purchase conversion via paywall-abandonment and post-registration triggered sequences.
  3. Measurable lift in month-1 rebill rate via differentiated and intervention flows.
  4. Add-on attach rate (Resume Review, Resume Builder) materially up via CRM-driven sales sequences.
  5. Per-flow incremental revenue reported weekly via proper holdout methodology.

12 Months

  1. CVM channel contributing as a top-3 incremental revenue source for the company.
  2. Cross-channel lifecycle strategy (email + SMS + web push + iMessage/RCS as those channels mature in the US) live and documented.
  3. Process documentation and tooling stable enough to remove key-person risk.


We keep our hiring process quick and simple:

  • HR Introduction Call
  • Team Interviews
  • Challenge
  • Reference Check (with three prior managers)


Requirements

You're a Fit If You Have

  • 3+ years operating CVM/lifecycle programs on the US market specifically. US b2c subscription. This is non-negotiable — US deliverability, US carriers, US consumer behavior, US compliance.
  • 5+ years total in CRM / lifecycle / CVM, with at least one stint owning the function end-to-end (not just executing).
  • Hands-on operating experience with an enterprise omnichannel platform — Maestra strongly preferred; Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, or Klaviyo also relevant.
  • Real, hands-on experience launching SMS as a marketing channel in the US (TCPA, A2P 10DLC, carrier compliance — not "I worked with a vendor who handled it").
  • Real, hands-on experience launching web push and measuring its lift.
  • SQL good enough to pull your own segments and validate your own data.
  • A subscription-business orientation: you think in LTV/payer, payback period, retention curves, and cohorts — not in opens and clicks.
  • A track record of measurable incremental revenue from CRM, ideally validated through holdout.
  • Bias toward action. We operate as a tiny team; you'll need to ship faster than you plan.

Nice to Have

  • Experience migrating off a damaged email domain.
  • Experience in job search, career, HR-tech, or adjacent consumer subscription verticals (EdTech, FinTech, dating, streaming).
  • iMessage Business / RCS experience.
  • Communication (speak English and Russian).


Benefits

  • Clear mandate and ownership from day one. You're the function, not a contributor to it.
  • The economics are highly leveraged — even a 5-percentage-point lift on month-1 rebill is meaningful to the bottom line of the company.
  • Direct work with the CMO, CEO, and Growth PM. No layers, no politics.
  • A market where your work is directly visible to users searching for their next job — outcomes you can feel.
  • $4000-7000/month + 38DaysOff.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure Platform
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada

This is Engineering at Lattice

Lattice’s Engineering team is continuously working to better both our product and our craft. We use a modern, cutting-edge tech stack and love experimenting with new technologies. We strive for maintainable, robust, and performant code. We’re highly collaborative and continuously iterative, and work closely with designers and product managers. We prioritize not only great technical architecture but also an amazing product experience.

The Infrastructure Platform team focuses on the cloud services, infrastructure, and internal platforms that power Lattice’s products. We build reliable, scalable pathways that make it easier for product engineers to develop, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot their services. 

What You Will Do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Infrastructure Platform team, you will work across a broad technical footprint, including AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, distributed systems, observability, deployment tooling, and internal developer platforms.

You will use your prior experience to understand how systems and services interact, identify gaps or sources of friction, and build platform capabilities that improve reliability and developer productivity.

  • Design, build, and operate AWS-based cloud infrastructure and platform services.
  • Create reusable internal platform capabilities that improve how engineers build, deploy, and operate services.
  • Work across AWS, Kubernetes, IaC, CI/CD, observability, and distributed systems.
  • Partner with product engineering to identify recurring needs and turn them into scalable platform solutions.
  • Evaluate system interactions, identify risks or inefficiencies, and drive improvements.
  • Improve reliability, performance, availability, and maintainability of production systems.
  • Define and promote platform practices (SLOs, monitoring, incident response, operational readiness).
  • Instrument, debug, and improve services and infrastructure (including TypeScript services).
  • Lead technical initiatives from problem definition through delivery and adoption.
  • Communicate tradeoffs, risks, and progress to engineering stakeholders.
  • Mentor engineers on building reliable, scalable systems.
  • Participate in on-call and incident response.

What You Will Bring to the Table

  • 5+ years of software or infrastructure engineering experience.
  • Deep AWS experience in production environments.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and system design.
  • Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or shared services.
  • Hands-on Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform a plus).
  • Strong programming skills and ability to debug production systems (TypeScript a plus).
  • Experience with CI/CD and automated deployment workflows.
  • Experience with observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLOs).
  • Ability to reason across complex systems and understand cross-component interactions.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives with multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and collaborative mindset.

Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.

____

The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $123,750 - CAD $165,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.

Benefits: The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical insurance; Dental insurance; Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance; Natural Disaster Support Program; Wellness Apps; Paid Parental Leave, Paid Time off inclusive of holidays and sick time; One time WFH Office Set-Up Stipend; Retirement Plan; Financial Planning; and Learning & Development Budget.

title: Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA (IA conversationnelle)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

Upgrade aide ses clients à avancer dans la bonne direction grâce à des produits financiers abordables et responsables. Depuis 2017, nous avons aidé plus de 7,5 millions de clients à accéder à plus de 42 milliards de dollars en crédit à la consommation. En nous concentrant sans relâche sur l'amélioration du bien-être financier de nos clients, nous développons des produits qui leur permettent de faire des économies et qui les soutiennent pour un meilleur avenir financier. Nous sommes soutenus par certains des meilleurs investisseurs dans le domaine de la technologie et avons été récemment valorisés à 7,3 milliards de dollars.

Nous sommes constamment reconnus pour notre culture de collaboration et d'inclusion. Plus récemment, nous avons été classés parmi les Premières entreprises fintech au monde par CNBC, Meilleurs lieux de travail par Built In, et par le San Francisco Business Times, Meilleurs lieux de travail d'Amérique par Newsweek, Meilleur employeur ''Startup'' par Forbes, et Employeurs les plus sains par Phoenix Business Journal.

Nous recherchons de nouveaux membres d'équipe qui sont enthousiastes à l'idée de concevoir et de proposer des produits nouveaux et meilleurs. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à bâtir un meilleur avenir financier pour des millions de personnes.

À propos du rôle

Un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA est responsable du cycle de vie complet des parcours que nos clients vivent avec l'agent IA d'Upgrade par clavardage, par téléphone et par courriel : création, optimisation, gestion des cas particuliers et augmentation du taux de résolution autonome. Cette personne conçoit des parcours dans les outils sans code de Sierra, collabore avec les groupes produits d'Upgrade pour intégrer leurs processus de service à l'agent, et répond de la capacité de l'agent à résoudre le problème du client de façon sécuritaire, exacte et sans intervention humaine.

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA pour prendre en charge l'agent IA d'Upgrade destiné à la clientèle. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes de développement, de produit et des opérations clientèle. Vous transformerez des processus de service, comme effectuer un paiement, consulter les détails d'un prêt, mettre à jour une adresse ou activer les paiements préautorisés, en parcours de production, et vous continuerez à les améliorer après leur lancement.

Vous concevrez et gérerez les parcours de A à Z, de la première ébauche jusqu'à leur pleine maturité. Le travail est à la fois celui d'un bâtisseur et d'un analyste : concevoir le parcours, gérer les cas particuliers, lire les transcriptions et augmenter continuellement le taux de résolution autonome. Le taux de résolution autonome, la satisfaction client (CSAT), la qualité des transferts et le taux d'hallucination sont vos indicateurs clés. Au cours de votre première année, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille de parcours couvrant l'ensemble de nos produits (prêts personnels, carte, paiement différé (BNPL), marge de crédit hypothécaire (HELOC), dépôts) et contribuerez à établir les normes selon lesquelles Upgrade conçoit, teste et déploie ses expériences IA.

Nos technologies principales

Sierra Agent Studio (parcours sans code), simulations et analyse des conversations Sierra, API GraphQL et REST (comme outils de parcours), Genesys (transfert vers le centre de contact), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, Claude et autres outils de LLM.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Création de parcours : Concevoir et développer des parcours Sierra dans Agent Studio pour le clavardage, la voix et le courriel, de la phase de découverte avec les opérations jusqu'au déploiement en production
  • Optimisation : Analyser chaque semaine les transcriptions, les enregistrements et les données analytiques, repérer où les conversations échouent ou sont transférées, et déployer des correctifs à la logique des parcours, aux instructions et à la base de connaissances
  • Gestion des cas particuliers : Cartographier les scénarios problématiques (paiements refusés, identité non concordante, comptes en souffrance, demandes non prises en charge) et s'assurer que chacun se conclut par une réponse exacte ou un transfert fluide
  • Résolution autonome : Assumer la responsabilité des cibles de résolution autonome et de CSAT pour chaque parcours, mener des déploiements progressifs (1 % → 100 %) et prioriser les travaux ayant le plus d'impact sur ces indicateurs
  • Partenariat produit : Collaborer avec les groupes produits (prêts personnels, carte, BNPL, dépôts) pour définir la portée de nouveaux parcours, maintenir les parcours à jour au fil de l'évolution des produits et définir les API dont l'agent a besoin
  • Sécurité et conformité : Appliquer l'authentification à plusieurs niveaux et la vérification renforcée, le libellé de conformité exact ainsi que des garde-fous contre les hallucinations et les réponses non conformes aux politiques
  • Transferts : Concevoir les transferts vers des agents humains dans Genesys avec des résumés exacts et le contexte d'authentification
  • Tests : Créer des suites de simulation et de tests de régression afin que chaque modification de parcours soit déployée avec la preuve qu'elle n'altère pas le comportement existant
  • Surveillance : Suivre la latence, les erreurs et les abandons dans SumoLogic et Grafana, et être responsable des alertes
  • Optimisation vocale : Latence, phrases de transition, interruptions, personnalité et ton
  • Relation avec Sierra : Agir à titre de responsable technique de notre côté, faire remonter les problèmes liés à la plateforme et orienter les demandes relatives à la feuille de route

Ce que nous recherchons

  • De 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel, ou une expérience équivalente dans des rôles en solutions techniques, en IA conversationnelle ou en gestion de produits techniques
  • Connaissance pratique du comportement des agents LLM : instructions, appels d'outils, récupération de connaissances, et les points de défaillance de chacun
  • Expérience dans la conception d'évaluations pour des systèmes non déterministes : jeux de tests, simulations, LLM évaluateur (LLM-as-judge), seuils de régression
  • Une maîtrise technique suffisante pour lire des spécifications d'API, collaborer avec des développeurs backend sur des intégrations REST et GraphQL, et raisonner sur les autorisations et les portées de permissions
  • Un esprit axé sur le produit et le client : vous comprenez les procédures opérationnelles, lisez les transcriptions, accordez de l'importance au ton et mesurez votre réussite selon la résolution du problème du client
  • Sens des responsabilités en production : déploiements, surveillance, analyse de journaux et réponse aux incidents
  • Rédaction claire et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs non techniques des équipes des opérations, de la conformité et des affaires juridiques

Atouts supplémentaires

  • Expérience pratique de Sierra Agent Studio ou d'une plateforme d'agents sans code comparable (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)
  • Expérience en IA vocale : reconnaissance vocale (speech-to-text), synthèse vocale (text-to-speech), optimisation de la latence, gestion des interruptions (barge-in)
  • Connaissance des systèmes de centre de contact tels que Genesys et de la conception de transferts vers des agents
  • Expérience en fintech ou dans un autre secteur réglementé (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)
  • Expérience en conception conversationnelle ou en rédaction UX

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Salaire compétitif ($140K-$180K) et plan d'options d'achat d'actions
  • Assurances médicales, dentaires et de la vue payées par l'entreprise
  • Congés payés flexibles
  • Possibilités de croissance et de développement professionnel
  • Congé parental payé
  • Initiatives de santé et de bien-être

Exigence linguistique

English language is required for this position, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide.

L'anglais est requis pour ce poste, puisqu'il comporte des interactions avec le personnel des bureaux d'Upgrade à l'échelle internationale.

Conditions environnementales et de travail

Le travail s'effectue à l'intérieur dans un environnement au rythme soutenu qui exige la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de respecter les processus de travail, les horaires et les attentes en matière de service établi.

Les employés saisissent, extraient et échangent régulièrement des informations avec précision à l'aide de systèmes et d'applications numériques afin d'appuyer les objectifs opérationnels et de service à la clientèle.

Le poste exige la capacité de recevoir et d'échanger des informations avec les clients, les collègues, les superviseurs et les partenaires interfonctionnels par le biais des moyens de communication disponibles, qui peuvent inclure des réunions, des courriels, des appels téléphoniques et des outils de collaboration numériques, et peut impliquer des échanges en temps réel, verbaux ou en personne selon les besoins de l'entreprise.

Les fonctions peuvent inclure la gestion d'un volume élevé d'interactions entrantes et/ou sortantes avec la clientèle ainsi que d'activités de travail à l'aide de systèmes de télécommunication et informatiques. Le poste exige la capacité de lire, d'analyser et d'interpréter les informations affichées à l'écran d'ordinateur et de maintenir une posture de travail pendant de longues périodes, conformément aux exigences du poste.

Le travail peut s'effectuer dans un centre de contact, un bureau ou en télétravail, selon les besoins de l'entreprise et la nature du poste. Les environnements de travail sur place peuvent inclure des espaces de travail partagés, un éclairage de bureau standard et un bruit de fond modéré typique des environnements de service à la clientèle ou opérationnels.

Les employés en télétravail sont responsables de maintenir un espace de travail sécurisé et productif avec une connexion Internet fiable qui prend en charge les systèmes de l'entreprise et protège la confidentialité des informations de l'entreprise et des clients.

Des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables peuvent être mises en place pour permettre aux personnes qualifiées vivant avec un handicap d'exercer les fonctions essentielles du poste, conformément à l'Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) et aux lois étatiques et locales applicables.

Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et nous valorisons la diversité au sein de notre entreprise. Nous ne faisons pas de discrimination fondée sur la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'âge, l'état civil, le statut d'ancien combattant ou le statut de handicap.

Upgrade n'accepte pas les candidatures spontanées soumises par des agences de recrutement, des cabinets de recherche de personnel ou toute autre tierce partie. Tout CV soumis à un employé d'Upgrade sans accord écrit préalable en vigueur sera considéré comme la propriété d'Upgrade, et Upgrade ne sera pas tenue de payer des bonus de recommandation ou de placement. Les agences doivent obtenir une approbation écrite au préalable du service d'acquisition de talents d'Upgrade pour soumettre des candidatures, et ce, seulement si une entente valide et dûment signée est en vigueur.

title: GTM Readiness Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada: Select locations

Role Description

As a GTM Readiness Manager within the GTM organization, you will help turn product and business changes into executable go-to-market motions. You will work across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Enablement, and Technology to ensure the business is operationally ready to bring new products, packaging, and other commercial changes to market.

You will play a critical role in translating product decisions into GTM requirements, identifying cross-functional dependencies, coordinating operational readiness, and ensuring the end-to-end customer and seller experience works as intended. This role sits at the intersection of product and commercial execution, giving you broad exposure across the business and the opportunity to improve how we bring increasingly complex products and commercial models to market.

You will serve as a critical connection point between Product and the teams responsible for bringing product changes to market, ensuring teams are aligned and operationally ready for launch. You will also help build and scale the GTM Readiness capability, creating clearer processes, identifying dependencies earlier, reducing launch friction, and enabling teams to move faster and execute with greater confidence.

Responsibilities

  • Own GTM readiness for product and commercial changes, including new product launches, pricing and packaging changes, new SKUs, migrations, deprecations, and changes to routes to market.
  • Translate product decisions into commercial and operational requirements across areas such as product catalog, pricing and approvals, contracting, Salesforce/CPQ, billing and ordering, provisioning and entitlements, compensation, reporting, and customer lifecycle.
  • Partner with Product teams early in the development lifecycle to understand upcoming changes, identify impacted GTM motions, and establish the decisions, owners, dependencies, and lead times required for readiness.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional readiness across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Enablement, GTM Technology, and other impacted teams, while maintaining clear accountability with the teams that own individual decisions and deliverables.
  • Drive end-to-end operational validation, defining critical business scenarios and ensuring appropriate owners validate the complete customer and seller experience across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, reporting, renewal, support, and other applicable workflows.
  • Identify and manage readiness risks, surfacing unresolved decisions, dependencies, and operational gaps early and driving them toward resolution or explicit risk acceptance before launch.
  • Improve the GTM Readiness operating model by creating reusable processes, launch patterns, requirements frameworks, and automation that reduce manual coordination and make future launches faster and more predictable.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of overall professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Systems, or another role supporting complex cross-functional GTM initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting product launches, pricing/packaging changes, commercial model changes, or other initiatives requiring coordination between Product and GTM teams.
  • Working knowledge of core SaaS commercial processes, including multiple areas such as opportunity-to-order, quoting/CPQ, pricing, contracting, billing, provisioning, renewals, compensation, or customer lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product or business needs into clear operational requirements, dependencies, decisions, and execution plans.
  • Experience independently coordinating complex initiatives across Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Sales, and other business functions without direct authority over participating teams.
  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to understand how a change in one part of the commercial lifecycle can affect downstream processes, systems, data, and customer experiences.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience documenting requirements, facilitating cross-functional decisions, communicating risks, and driving clarity among stakeholders with different priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a B2B SaaS or subscription-based business with multiple products, customer segments, or routes to market.
  • Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, billing, commerce, provisioning, entitlement, or other systems supporting the quote-to-cash/customer lifecycle.
  • Experience designing or improving product launch, commercialization, or GTM readiness processes rather than solely executing within an established process.
  • Experience supporting products sold through multiple motions, such as self-service, direct sales, channel, reseller, or partner ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with automation and AI capabilities that can simplify requirements gathering, dependency management, testing, and operational readiness.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

Canada Pay Range$124,100—$167,900 CAD

title: Category Manager - Apparel
description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.

Why you’ll love this role:

StockX is the world’s leading marketplace for current culture, built at the intersection of commerce, community, and credibility. Apparel is foundational to StockX — not just as a category, but as an expression of identity, culture, and global trends.

We are expanding how apparel culture shows up on StockX through creator-driven, community-oriented commerce experiences that blend storytelling, expertise, and transaction. To do this well, we need category leaders who don’t just understand the apparel market — they live inside it.

The Apparel Category Manager is the single-threaded owner of apparel category growth within a new, high-priority commerce initiative. This person is the in-house expert on Fashion & Apparel culture, people, economics, and moments — and is responsible for translating that expertise into supply growth, engagement, and GMV.

You will act as:

  • The internal authority on the first-hand and second-hand apparel ecosystem
  • The external face of StockX to apparel sellers, creators, designers, and community leaders
  • The architect of the apparel go-to-market playbook for this new initiative

This role blends deep cultural fluency, strategic ownership, and hands-on execution. Early on, you will own everything related to apparel within this initiative. As the category scales, you will grow into a leader overseeing a broader apparel portfolio and team.

What You’ll Do:

Own the Apparel Category End-to-End

  • Define and execute the growth strategy for apparel within the platform
  • Own category-level performance across supply, engagement, and revenue
  • Establish quarterly goals, leading indicators, and operating rhythms

Be the Market & Culture Expert

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of apparel culture, including:
    • Key sellers, creators, designers, brands, and retailers
    • Sub-segments (streetwear, luxury, contemporary, vintage, performance, regional styles, etc.)
    • Seasonal drops, brand dynamics, collaborations, and cultural moments
    • Pricing dynamics, liquidity, and resale economics
  • Serve as the internal voice of the apparel community, informing product, marketing, and platform decisions

Supply & Creator Acquisition

  • Build and own a pipeline of high-impact apparel sellers, shops, designers, influencers, brands, and creators
  • Personally recruit and onboard flagship sellers who set the tone for the platform
  • Develop seller strategies that balance credibility, storytelling, and commerce

Commerce Strategy & Category Moments

  • Identify and orchestrate Fashion & Apparel-specific moments, campaigns, and formats that drive engagement and conversion
  • Partner with Category Marketing to design culturally authentic activations
  • Experiment with new approaches and iterate quickly based on performance and feedback

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Work closely with Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller acquisition and support
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape features and tools that matter to category sellers and buyers
  • Provide clear, actionable insights from the market to influence roadmap prioritization

Build the Playbook

  • Document learnings, frameworks, and best practices that can be reused across future categories
  • Help define what “great” looks like for category ownership at StockX
  • Support hiring and onboarding as the apparel category team grows

About you:

  • Deeply embedded in second-hand fashion & apparel culture — you know the people, platforms, trends, and economics, and you’re already plugged into the ecosystem
  • 5+ years of experience in category management, partnerships, marketplace growth, brand, or operator roles in apparel, streetwear, fashion, or adjacent ecosystems
  • Comfortable owning outcomes, not just strategy — you execute, iterate, and adapt
  • Strong relationship builder with credibility among sellers, creators, designers, and community members
  • Data-literate and commercially minded — you understand pricing, margins, liquidity, and incentives
  • Entrepreneurial, scrappy, and energized by building something from the ground up

Nice to Have:

  • Existing network of apparel resellers, brand operators, designers, boutiques, or creators
  • Experience buying and selling apparel or operating within resale or fashion marketplaces
  • Familiarity with content-driven commerce, creator platforms, or enthusiast communities
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams
  • Experience running your own business or startup

Why This Role Matters:

Apparel will define the early perception and success of this new commerce initiative at StockX. This role sets:

  • The cultural bar for the platform
  • The go-to-market blueprint for future categories
  • The credibility of StockX with the apparel community

You will have outsized influence on how StockX expands its leadership from marketplace into deeper cultural engagement.

title: Senior Contracts Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

This is Legal at Lattice

The Lattice Legal team is looking for an experienced, business-minded Senior Contracts Manager to help lead our commercial contracting function. In this role, you will independently manage a broad portfolio of customer, vendor, partnership, and other commercial agreements while serving as a trusted adviser to teams across the company.

You will be expected to understand Lattice’s business, products, contracting standards, and risk framework well enough to resolve most matters independently, identify practical paths through difficult negotiations, and escalate issues with a clear assessment and recommendation. The right candidate combines strong contract judgment, operational discipline, commercial awareness, and fluency with modern legal technology and AI-assisted workflows.

This is a highly cross-functional role supporting Sales, Deal Desk, Procurement, Privacy, Security, Finance, Product, Partnerships, Marketing, and other business teams. Success requires balancing thoughtful risk management with a practical focus on customer experience, business velocity, and scalable operations.

What You Will Do

  • Independently draft, review, negotiate, and manage a high volume of commercial agreements within Lattice’s contracting playbooks, approval framework, and risk tolerances.
  • Lead negotiations involving SaaS order forms, terms of service, master services agreements, data processing agreements, service level agreements, amendments, renewals, trials, AI-related terms, termination agreements, and related customer documents.
  • Review and negotiate vendor, supplier, and service-provider agreements, coordinating with Procurement, Privacy, Security, Finance, and business owners based on the services involved and the risks presented.
  • Support technology partnerships, integrations, referral programs, sponsorships, events, speaker engagements, and other strategic or marketing relationships.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact between Legal and business stakeholders, providing practical guidance on contract structure, risk allocation, negotiation strategy, approval requirements, and escalation paths.
  • Exercise independent judgment to resolve matters within established parameters and promptly escalate material legal, financial, privacy, security, product, or operational risks with a concise analysis and recommended approach.
  • Partner with Privacy, Security, Product, Finance, and other subject-matter experts to ensure contractual commitments are accurate, operationally feasible, properly approved, and tracked where appropriate.
  • Manage numerous concurrent negotiations with strong prioritization, responsiveness, and ownership from intake through signature.
  • Maintain accurate contract records, approvals, metadata, and final documentation across Ironclad, Salesforce, Zip, and related systems.
  • Identify recurring negotiation patterns, operational friction, and emerging risks, and translate those observations into improvements to templates, playbooks, fallback positions, training, and self-service resources.
  • Use approved AI and legal technology tools to accelerate contract review, compare proposed language against playbooks, identify issues, support drafting, summarize negotiations, and improve reporting and workflow efficiency.
  • Help develop meaningful reporting on contract volume, cycle time, negotiation trends, escalations, and other indicators that can improve the contracting function and the broader business.
  • Stay informed about developments affecting commercial contracting, SaaS businesses, data privacy, AI-enabled products, and contracting technology.

What You Will Bring to the Table

  • Five or more years of relevant experience negotiating and managing commercial technology agreements, preferably in a high-growth SaaS or technology company. Equivalent combinations of legal, contracts, and business experience will be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer-facing SaaS negotiations, including master agreements, subscription terms, data processing agreements, service level agreements, and related commercial documents.
  • Experience reviewing technology vendor and procurement agreements. 
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material risk from lower-value negotiating points.
  • Ability to apply playbooks and policies thoughtfully, identify matters outside established parameters, and present escalation issues with practical recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of common SaaS contracting issues, including intellectual property, confidentiality, data use, privacy, security, indemnification, limitations of liability, SLAs, warranties, renewals, and termination rights.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex contract issues clearly to business stakeholders and counterparties.
  • Excellent organizational and project-management skills, with demonstrated success managing a large and changing portfolio of matters with limited supervision.
  • A collaborative approach and a record of building trusted relationships across Sales, Deal Desk, Procurement, Finance, Privacy, Security, Product, and other functions.
  • Meaningful experience using AI-assisted tools for contract review, drafting, analysis, knowledge management, or workflow automation, together with sound judgment regarding confidentiality, accuracy, and responsible use.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word and experience with contract lifecycle management and procurement platforms.
  • Experience with Ironclad, Salesforce, Zip, Google Workspace, Slack, and Excel is preferred.
  • Experience working with international counterparties and modern privacy and AI regulatory frameworks is a plus.

title: Principal Competitive Intelligence Manager
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

6sense Product Marketing

Principal Competitive Intelligence Manager

Competitive Intelligence & Win/Loss

Team: Product Marketing
Reports to: VP, Product Marketing
Level: Principal  

About the Role

The market we compete in is being redrawn in real time. Point data providers are moving up the stack. Workflow and enrichment tools are repositioning as operating systems. Buyers are assembling their own stacks from components that used to be bought as a platform. Knowing what each competitor shipped last quarter is table stakes — the job is understanding what the pattern means and what we should do about it.

This role owns competitive intelligence and win/loss for 6sense. It sits on the Product Marketing team and exists so that our positioning, our roadmap conversations and our field enablement are built on evidence rather than assumption. You will be the person the company turns to when there is a disagreement about why we win, why we lose, and who we are actually competing against.

This is a senior individual contributor seat. The work is research, synthesis and judgment — and the willingness to tell the company something it would rather not hear, with the evidence to back it up.

What You'll Own

  • The win/loss program, end to end. Interviews, coding, synthesis and the readouts that go to product and executive leadership. Not administering a program — making it the thing people trust when they disagree.

  • Competitive positioning and differentiation. The evidence behind our claims about where we are stronger, and the honesty about where we are not. You partner with the pillar PMMs so competitive insight shapes positioning rather than trailing it.

  • Structural market analysis. How buyers are assembling their stacks, where substitution is happening, which categories are converging, and what that means for us eighteen months out.

  • Field enablement for competitive situations. Battlecards, objection handling, trap-setting questions and talk tracks that hold up in a live deal rather than in a deck.

  • Claims discipline for competitive material. Sourcing every competitive number we put in front of a customer, and saying no to the ones we cannot stand behind.

  • Competitive monitoring and alerting, including ownership of the tooling and of what reaches the field versus what stays internal.

  • Input to roadmap, pricing and packaging, and analyst relations. Competitive evidence should shape what we build and how we price, not only how we sell.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in competitive intelligence, product marketing or research-heavy go-to-market roles in B2B SaaS.

  • Hands-on win/loss experience. Designing the program, running the interviews and coding the results — not reading someone else's summary.

  • The ability to run primary research and be honest about what the data does and does not support. Small samples are useful; presenting them as more than they are is not.

  • Strong synthesis and writing. An executive should be able to read your analysis and know what to do differently.

  • Comfort presenting uncomfortable findings to product and executive audiences, and holding them under pushback.

  • Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, sales intelligence or data platforms.

  • Working knowledge of AI and agentic tooling — enough to evaluate what a competitor has actually shipped versus announced.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with competitive intelligence and research tooling (Klue, Gong, Dovetail or equivalent).

  • Analyst relations exposure with Gartner or Forrester.

  • Background in or adjacent to ABM, intent data, GTM intelligence or revenue platforms.

  • Experience building a competitive intelligence function rather than inheriting one.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, win/loss is a program leaders act on rather than a report they receive; we know with evidence why we win and lose, by competitor and by segment; the field has competitive material that holds up in a live deal; and every competitive claim we make in market has a source behind it.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

 

Our Core Technologies

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

 

What You'll Do

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

 

What We Look For:

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

 

Nice To Have:

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

• Conversation design or UX writing experience

 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives
